summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund typically invests at least 40% of its net assets in securities of issuers or companies that are economically tied to countries outside the United States. The fund will not invest more than 25% of its net assets in emerging markets and will only invest in foreign securities listed on U.S. exchanges or in the form of depositary receipts. The fund is non-diversified.
